$description: Which Figma variable goes on which property of each component. Read from Bootstrap 6 (assets/bootstrap.min.css, bootstrap-v6-dev@bc4bcb4) plus filmmakers.css. Bootstrap's --bs-theme-* tokens become the theme's own roles: in theme-primary, --bs-theme-bg is primary/bg. Use these, never a palette/* colour.

all.iconColour: same as text, except Client zone

states.$description: State colours are generated per primary into figma/tokens.json as button/<type>/<state>/<fill|stroke|text|ring>, for example button/primary/hover/fill. Primary and Row action live in the Primary collection, so they follow the mode; the rest live in Theme. Full values: figma/button-states.json.
states.hover: button/<type>/hover/*. Bootstrap darkens the colour by 5% (oklch). Text buttons gain a tinted fill.
states.active: button/<type>/active/*. The .active or .show class: a toggled button, or a menu trigger whose menu is open. Darkens by 10%. Bootstrap 6 has no separate mouse-down style.
states.focus: Default colours plus a 3px ring, 1px outside the button, in always-blue/focus-ring (button/<type>/focus/ring). Never the customer primary.
states.loading: Not defined. Bootstrap 6 has no loading button, and the Buttons guideline lists loading buttons as not yet covered. ASK.
